query: DO $$ DECLARE v_template_id UUID; BEGIN SELECT id INTO v_template_id FROM public.inspection_templates WHERE code = 'government-hospital-accreditation'; IF v_template_id IS NOT NULL THEN DELETE FROM public.inspection_template_items WHERE template_id = v_template_id AND section_code = 'DRUGS'; INSERT INTO public.inspection_template_items (template_id, section_code, item_code, item_label, response_type, max_points, sort_order) VALUES (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_1', 'Is the pharmacy/dispensary adequately stocked with ACT, Antibacterial, Antihypertensive, Antidiabetic drugs etc.?', 'boolean', 0, 1), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_2', 'Prescribed drugs (appropriateness, dose & duration)', 'boolean', 0, 2), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_3', 'Is Drug Revolving Fund (DRF) Committee in place and functional?', 'boolean', 0, 3), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_3a', 'If no, how do you ensure availability of drugs in the hospital?', 'text', 0, 4), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_4', 'Availability of drug counseling', 'boolean', 0, 5), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_5', 'Provision for out-of-stock (O/S) for enrollees', 'boolean', 0, 6), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_5a', 'If yes, what does facility do?', 'text', 0, 7), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_6', 'Adequate drug storage with A/C', 'boolean', 0, 8), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_7', 'Assess the drug store for labelling', 'boolean', 0, 9), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q018_8', 'Amount budgeted for drugs per month/quarter (record the figure)', 'text', 0, 10), (v_template_id, 'DRUGS', 'Q019_DRUGS', 'How much did you generate apart from ORANGHIS fund? · Quarter: (select quarter)', 'text', 0, 11); END IF; END $$;
